quotationNarrative: A premium, personalized 8-day private journey crafted by Capella Travel for our guests. The itinerary showcases the historic soul of Hanoi, the mystical rivers of Ninh Binh, an overnight cruise through the magical waters of Ha Long Bay, and the breathtaking terraced mountains of Sapa. Every detail, from the double and triple room configurations to the carefully curated vegetarian culinary experiences, has been designed for your group of 5 adults to travel in ultimate comfort.

whyWorks.privateFlexible: Travel in complete exclusivity with your private air-conditioned vehicle and dedicated English-speaking guide. The daily pacing is highly flexible, ensuring your group can explore Sapa, Hanoi, Ninh Binh, and Halong Bay comfortably at your own speed.
whyWorks.comfort: Enjoy premium accommodations including Sapa Jade Hill, Hanoi Le Jardin Hotel & Spa, and Ambassador Signature Cruise in Halong. For the overnight train journey back to Hanoi, we have pre-arranged 2 private 4-berth cabins on the Chapa Express Train to guarantee absolute privacy and space for your group of 5.
whyWorks.muslimFriendly: Your dietary requirements are fully respected. All included meals feature carefully curated Indian vegetarian selections, with eggs permitted and strictly no meat, fish, or seafood. Restaurants and cruise chefs are briefed to prevent cross-contamination.
whyWorks.balancedHighlights: A perfect harmony of highland exploration in Sapa, historic culture in Hanoi, scenic rivers in Ninh Binh, and a luxury overnight cruise in Halong Bay, offering a complete northern Vietnam experience in 8 days.

itinerary.summary: Arrive at Noi Bai International Airport in Hanoi. After a warm welcome and breakfast, board your private luxury vehicle for a scenic drive to the mountainous region of Sapa (approx. 5-6 hours). Arrive at Sapa Jade Hill and check in. Enjoy a relaxed evening and a gourmet Indian vegetarian welcome dinner.
itinerary.mainInclusions: VIP Airport Fast-track, private airport transfer to Sapa, Indian vegetarian welcome dinner.

itinerary.summary: Embark on a guided trekking tour to Cat Cat village, learning about the Black Hmong culture and viewing the scenic waterfall. Savor a local vegetarian lunch. Spend a relaxed afternoon exploring Sapa town or enjoying the resort's facilities. Overnight at Sapa Jade Hill.
itinerary.mainInclusions: Sapa tour with guide and entry tickets, vegetarian lunch.

itinerary.summary: A highlights day in Sapa! Take the Fansipan cable car, the longest three-rope cable car system in the world, to ascend the 'Roof of Indochina' at 3,143 meters. Explore the spiritual pagoda complex at the summit. Enjoy a scenic vegetarian lunch. In the afternoon, visit Ta Van village. Overnight at Sapa Jade Hill.
itinerary.mainInclusions: Fansipan cable car roundtrip tickets, guide, Sapa transfers, vegetarian lunch.

itinerary.summary: Enjoy a free day to relax at Sapa Jade Hill, shop for souvenirs in Sapa town, or explore at your own pace. In the late afternoon, transfer to Lao Cai station. Board the Chapa Express Train for your overnight journey back to Hanoi in pre-arranged private 4-berth cabins.
itinerary.mainInclusions: Station transfer, Chapa Express Train tickets.

itinerary.summary: Arrive at Hanoi station early in the morning and transfer to Hanoi Le Jardin Hotel & Spa for a hot breakfast and early check-in (subject to availability). Enjoy a full-day city tour of Hanoi, visiting the historic Temple of Literature, Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum complex, and Hoan Kiem Lake. Savor a vegetarian dinner in the Old Quarter.
itinerary.mainInclusions: Station transfer, Hanoi full-day tour with guide and entry tickets, vegetarian lunch & dinner.

itinerary.summary: Embark on a full-day private excursion to Ninh Binh. Experience the serene beauty of Trang An landscape complex, a UNESCO World Heritage site, during a traditional rowboat tour through limestone caves. Visit the ancient capital of Hoa Lu and climb to the peak of Mua Cave for panoramic views over the rice fields. Return to Hanoi in the late afternoon.
itinerary.mainInclusions: Private roundtrip vehicle to Ninh Binh, English guide, Trang An boat tour, Mua Cave entry, vegetarian lunch.

itinerary.summary: Depart Hanoi by private vehicle to Halong Bay. Board the premium Ambassador Signature Cruise, where your Double and Triple cabins await. Glide past iconic karst formations and enjoy a delicious vegetarian buffet lunch on board. Participate in cruise activities including a bamboo boat ride or kayaking.
itinerary.mainInclusions: Private transfer Hanoi - Halong, double & triple cabins on Ambassador Signature Cruise, cruise excursions, onboard vegetarian lunch and dinner.

itinerary.summary: Greet the sunrise with Tai Chi on the sundeck. After a vegetarian brunch, check out and disembark. Transfer back to Noi Bai International Airport by private luxury vehicle for your international departure flight.
itinerary.mainInclusions: Onboard vegetarian brunch, private transfer Halong - Hanoi Airport.
